text: Right, this is my third attempt at getting hold of someone tonight so I'm just going to put it all down here. My stepdaughter is 3 and her temp is 39.1. The bit that's got me wound up is her crying, it isn't her normal cry at all, it's this thin, high, weak sort of noise and it just keeps going and going, she's not really bawling the way she does when she's cross, it's more like a whimper that won't stop. Her mum says she's never heard her make that sound. And she keeps pushing her face into the pillow away from the lamp, we put the big light on to check her and she covered her eyes and said the light hurts and to turn it off. We've had to sit with her in the dark with just the hallway light. I've been on hold, cut off, told to try the website, and frankly I'm fed up of going round in circles when I've got a poorly kid here. Can somebody just tell us what we're supposed to do
